--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,38 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    matrices = (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call)
+    validated = []
+    for matrix in matrices:
+        array = np.asarray(matrix)
+        if array.ndim != 2 or array.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError("log-probability inputs must be nonempty matrices")
+        if not np.issubdtype(array.dtype, np.number):
+            raise ValueError("log-probability inputs must be numeric")
+        if not np.isfinite(array).all() or (array > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError("log probabilities must be finite and nonpositive")
+        validated.append(array.astype(float, copy=False))
+
+    with_result, call_only, no_call = validated
+    if call_only.shape != with_result.shape or no_call.shape != with_result.shape:
+        raise ValueError("log-probability matrices must have matching shapes")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
+    try:
+        threshold = float(tau_filter)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number") from None
+    if not np.isfinite(threshold) or threshold < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
+
+    # Toolformer compares the call-with-result loss against the better of the
+    # call-without-result and no-call counterfactuals over the future tokens.
+    score_with_result = np.sum(with_result, axis=1)
+    score_without_result = np.maximum(
+        np.sum(call_only, axis=1),
+        np.sum(no_call, axis=1),
+    )
+    margins = score_with_result - score_without_result
+    if not np.isfinite(margins).all():
+        raise ValueError("aggregated losses must be finite")
+    return margins >= threshold, margins
